text:
maria (PM): Quick sync — we need to finalize Q2 hosted-API scope today. Main tradeoff: capacity (Dedicated/hosted throughput) vs output quality (rerank + embedding fidelity). customers asking for predictable latency and better rerank accuracy.
kevin (Eng): quick question — do we have a hard SLA target change request from sales?
jen (Customer Success): only two enterprise customers asked for 99th pct latency guarantees for chat (for peak load spikes) and a strict rerank determinism req. both are willing to pay for reserved capacity.
sasha (ML): rerank determinism often means moving from approximate ANN to exact or hybrid retrieval, which increases cost ~2-4x. We can mitigate with distillation for reranker but needs 3–4 weeks.
olivia (Infra): capacity-wise, we can carve dedicated pools but autoscaling for spikes is still noisy. If we reserve GPUs we can hit latency SLOs but waste at idle. Need commitment level.
dan (SRE): we should model tail behavior. If customers want 99th percentile, small mis-batching can blow the tail. Recommend canaries with synthetic tail traffic.
liam (Prod Ops): pricing ask: sales wants a clear uplift formula for reserved capacity + SLA add-on. We need per-token baseline and delta for reserved throughput.
maria (PM): proposal: two parallel slices — "Conservative SLA" (reserved capacity + deterministic rerank opt-in) and "Cost-Optimized" (shared hosted with quantization + caching). Decide which to ship as beta for Q2 GA.
kevin (Eng): engineering estimate: Conservative SLA -> 6 wks work (pool config, rollout, billing hooks). Cost-Optimized -> 4 wks (quant profiles, cache heuristics). Both need infra changes.
sasha (ML): for Cost-Optimized we suggest 3 quantization profiles: 8-bit, 6-bit, 4-bit. Recommend shipping 8-bit first; 4-bit needs evals for hallucination/regression.
jen (Customer Success): can we scope a pilot with the two enterprise customers for Conservative SLA? they'd sign a short pilot (1 month) if latency and rerank meet thresholds.
olivia (Infra): pilot sounds fine. Need a clear canary plan and dedicated pool sizes. Can we get expected qps and p95/p99 numbers?
maria (PM): ask sales for numbers; for planning assume pilot qps 200 sustained, peaks 800. Target p99 < 350ms for chat. For rerank aim for top-1 stability > 95% vs ground truth testset.
dan (SRE): I'll set up a synthetic traffic harness to replay peak patterns and measure p99 under different batching windows.
kevin (Eng): rollout plan suggestion: alpha (internal) -> pilot (enterprise) -> GA. Alpha runs cost-optimized profile so we can catch regressions early.
sasha (ML): need evaluation harness for rerank regression alerts. I'll add threshold tests to Redwood evals and wire to console alerts.
liam (Prod Ops): product ask: define launch criteria as a checklist: (1) p99 within target under pilot load, (2) rerank stability threshold passed, (3) billing uplift validated, (4) rollback plan tested.
maria (PM): agreed. Also document opt-in flags: host.sla_mode=true and model.rerank_mode=deterministic in config. Example: ```json
{
  "host": {"sla_mode": true},
  "model": {"rerank_mode": "deterministic", "quant_profile": "8bit"}
}
```
kevin (Eng): noted. I'll add feature flags and rollout YAML.
jen (Customer Success): I'll set expectations with customers and gather explicit agreement on cost delta.
olivia (Infra): timeline check — infra changes + billing hooks + canary harness -> 5 weeks if we prioritize. If we parallelize with ML and Eng, maybe 4.
maria (PM): decision needed: do we ship both slices in Q2 (one as paid pilot, one as public opt-in)? or only one to focus engineering? Vote please: A=both, B=Conservative only, C=Cost-Optimized only.
kevin (Eng): B (Conservative only) — reduces surface area and billing complexity.
sasha (ML): C (Cost-Optimized only) — easier to iterate on quant and caching, less ops toil.
jen (Customer Success): A — customers want both choices; pilots can help validate revenue.
dan (SRE): B — safer for SLOs.
liam (Prod Ops): A if we can parallelize.
olivia (Infra): B unless extra headcount.
maria (PM): tally so far: A:2, B:3, C:1. Leaning B. I'll align with sales and execs after lunch and lock scope.
kevin (Eng): if B, we should still run internal cost-optimized experiments in alpha to gather data.
sasha (ML): agreed. I'll run evals on quant profiles internally and share regression matrices.
maria (PM): action items: Kevin -> feature flags + rollout YAML (due Thu). Olivia -> infra pool config + canary harness (due Fri). Sasha -> rerank evals & quant regression report (due next Wed). Jen -> pilot contracts & qps numbers (due Thu). Dan -> synthetic traffic harness (due Fri). Liam -> pricing delta formula draft (due Thu).
depot-bot: new canary job scheduled: hosted-api-canary/redwood-chat-v2 at 1983503200
maria (PM): thanks all — will follow up with a short doc and a decision note. If anything blocks, ping here. :thumbsup:
kevin (Eng): ack
sasha (ML): ack
jen (Customer Success): ack
liam (Prod Ops): ack
olivia (Infra): ack
dan (SRE): ack
